import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Melt the dataset to prepare for plotting
melted_data = pd.melt(data, id_vars='species', value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'])

# Create a boxplot for each species
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='species', y='value', data=melted_data)
plt.title('Iris Species Comparison of Sepal and Petal Measurements')
plt.xlabel('Species')
plt.ylabel('Measurement (cm)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Measurement Type')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Melt the dataset to prepare for plotting
melted_data = pd.melt(data, id_vars='species', value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'])

# Create a boxplot for each species
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='species', y='value', data=melted_data)
plt.title('Iris Species Comparison of Sepal and Petal Measurements')
plt.xlabel('Species')
plt.ylabel('Measurement (cm)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Measurement Type')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
